sentences.text: A bird's wing is strong.
A wing opens when flying.
An injured wing does not move.
The belly is full after dinner.
The belly hurts today.
The child touches a belly.
The guts are inside.
The doctor talks about the guts.
They removed the fish guts.
The neck hurts from sitting long.
A scarf covers the neck.
He turns his neck.
The back hurts when lifting.
Rest your back against the chair.
Keep your back straight.
The breast rises while breathing.

sentences.target: թռչունը տաքացնում է ձագերին կուրծք տակ։
sentences.text: A bird warms chicks under its breast.
The breast hurts when coughing.
The heart is beating fast.

sentences.target: սիրտ ուժեղ է առողջ մարդու մոտ։
sentences.text: The heart is strong in a healthy person.

sentences.target: վազելուց հետո սիրտ արագ է աշխատում։
sentences.text: After running the heart works fast.
The liver is an important organ.
The doctor checks the liver.
The liver cleans the blood.
I like to drink tea.

sentences.target: տաք օրերին հաճելի է խմել ջուր։
sentences.text: On hot days it is pleasant to drink water.
The child is learning to drink from a cup.
We like to eat together.
It is time to eat dinner.
The guests begin to eat.

sentences.target: շունը կարող է կծել եթե վախենա։
sentences.text: A dog may bite if it is afraid.
Do not try to bite the hard apple.
The child is learning to bite bread.
The baby begins to suck milk.
A bee can suck nectar.
It is pleasant to suck ice cream.
Do not start to spit on the floor.
The athlete has to spit water.

sentences.target: հիվանդին ասում են թքել բաժակի մեջ։
sentences.text: They tell the patient to spit into a cup.
At sea it is easy to vomit.
The child began to vomit at night.
The patient cannot vomit now.
The wind begins to blow hard.
The child likes to blow out the candle.
One must blow the dust from the table.
In the mountains it is hard to breathe.
Calmly try to breathe deeply.

sentences.target: վազելուց հետո պետք է շնչել դանդաղ։
sentences.text: After running one must breathe slowly.
Friends like to laugh together.
The film makes you laugh.
The child begins to laugh loudly.
One can see the mountain from afar.
It is pleasant to see a friend at the market.
The child is learning to see the letters.
It is pleasant to hear the music.
At night one can hear the wind.
The child is learning to hear carefully.
One must know the answer.
It is good to know the truth.
The student begins to know the rules.
It is good to think about peace.
He likes to think slowly.
Before sleep I begin to think.
It is pleasant to smell the flowers.

sentences.target: խոհարարը սիրում է հոտ առնել ապուրը։
sentences.text: The cook likes to smell the soup.
The child is learning to smell.
It is easy to fear the dark.
One may fear dogs.
The child begins to fear thunder.
At night it is pleasant to sleep deeply.
The child likes to sleep early.
A tired person begins to sleep.
In the city it is possible to live quietly.
It is pleasant to live in a village.
It is good for a family to live together.

sentences.target: ծեր ծառը կարող է մեռնել ձմռանը։
sentences.text: An old tree may die in winter.

sentences.target: առանց ջրի բույսը սկսում է մեռնել։
sentences.text: Without water a plant begins to die.
A sick animal may die.
The hunter does not wish to kill a bird.
Poison can kill an insect.
In war it is hard to kill.
The boys begin to fight in the yard.
Do not like to fight with friends.

sentences.target: շները կարող են կռվել ոսկորի համար։
sentences.text: Dogs may fight over a bone.
The cat likes to hunt mice.
In the forest one may hunt carefully.
The eagle begins to hunt.
One can hit the wall with a ball.
Do not start to hit the table.
With a hammer it is easy to hit a nail.
Bread is easy to cut with a knife.
In the garden they begin to cut branches.
Paper can be cut with scissors.
Wood is easy to split with an axe.

sentences.target: խնձորը կարելի է բաժանել երկու մասի։
sentences.text: An apple can be split into two parts.

sentences.target: աշխատանքը պետք է բաժանել ընկերների միջև։
sentences.text: The work must be split among friends.
Do not try to stab with a knife.
A hunter may stab a fish.
Be careful so you do not stab your hand.
The cat likes to scratch the sofa.
Thorns can scratch the skin.
The child begins to scratch an itch.
In the garden it is pleasant to dig the soil.
The dog likes to dig a hole.
In autumn they begin to dig potatoes.
It is pleasant to swim in the lake.
In summer children like to swim.
A beginner learns to swim slowly.
Birds like to fly high.
The airplane begins to fly.
In a dream one can fly.
It is pleasant to walk in the park.
Walking slowly suits a tired person.
In the evening I like to walk in the open air.
Friends begin to come in the evening.
The bus should come soon.
Guests like to come early.
It is pleasant to lie in the shade.
The dog likes to lie on the rug.
The patient must lie quietly.
It is pleasant to sit on the bench.

sentences.target: հյուրերը սկսում են նստել սեղանի շուրջ։
sentences.text: Guests begin to sit around the table.
In class one must sit attentively.
